events.outcome: Current 26 August 2026 Pantas terms say the plan is available to customers changing from another prepaid plan and charge RM2 for the successful rate-plan change. Current Hotlink Prepaid starter pricing is RM10. The Pantas FAQ still exposes legacy/direct starter-pack wording, so normalize a conservative current acquisition path as RM10 Hotlink Prepaid starter plus RM2 plan change rather than assuming a directly sold Pantas starter is universally available.

For eligible non-tourist Pantas service, Hotlink documents an RM30 365-day Active Period pass. After an ordinary active period ends, a 30-day Credit Grace Period allows incoming calls and SMS only; failing to top up before the grace period ends terminates the plan. The RM2/RM4/RM10 products with 365-day validity are internet passes, not SIM-validity substitutes.

Current Hotlink Pantas terms explicitly exclude tourist registrations from the normal Active Period, Credit Grace Period and 365-day SIM-validity clauses. Tourist service validity remains fixed at 90 days from original activation and is not extended, renewed or reset by plan switching, top-up or internet-pass purchase.

Hotlink supports new prepaid eSIM registration in the app and passport-based self-registration for non-Malaysians with ID scan and Face ID. These capabilities do not establish whether every non-Malaysian/passport registration is treated as a tourist under the 90-day lifecycle rule, so passport eligibility must not be equated with 365-day retention eligibility.

Hotlink Prepaid roaming is provisioned by default and relies on destination partner networks. A September 2026 Pantas user reported being unable to receive roaming SMS while the line and roaming were active; the user said support cited a minimum-balance requirement that was not published on the website. Other 2026 independent reports describe successful offshore eSIM setup only after adding sufficient prepaid balance. Preserve overseas incoming-SMS reachability as unquantified and balance-sensitive rather than guaranteed.

September 2026 users report the RM30/365-day validity option remains visible after switching to Pantas, including a reported RM2 plan-switch fee. This independently corroborates continued real-world availability but is not used to override first-party lifecycle or tourist rules.

data.tariffSummary: Conservative setup path RM12 = RM10 Hotlink Prepaid starter baseline + RM2 Pantas plan change. Eligible non-tourist Pantas: RM30/365-day Active Period pass; normal expiry then 30-day incoming-call/SMS-only grace. Tourist registrations: fixed 90 days from original activation and non-extendable by plan switch/top-up/internet pass.
guideSteps: Before relying on the route for long-term retention, establish whether Hotlink will classify the intended registration as tourist; passport self-registration alone does not prove 365-day eligibility.
For the conservative current path, start with a Hotlink Prepaid line and switch to Pantas in the app for the documented RM2 change fee.
For an eligible non-tourist Pantas line, buy the RM30 365-day Active Period pass. Do not confuse the RM2/RM4/RM10 365-day data passes with SIM validity.
Do not use this as a long-term retention route if the line is tourist-classified: current terms fix validity at 90 days and prevent extension by top-up/pass/plan switch.
For overseas recovery, verify roaming partner coverage and practical SMS receipt before relying on the line for critical OTP.
